notes: from is Vilarinho (end of stage 1). via in walking order: Arcos (freguesia, linked_place=village), São Pedro de Rates (relation/5937224: OSM name 'Rates', its linked place and alt_name are 'São Pedro de Rates'; the point is 0.65 km from the OSM route), Pedra Furada (relation/4056539, boundary=historic, on the Rother elevation profile), Carvalhal. Barcelos: relation/3737586 (linked_place=city); the OSM route passes through that point (Vagamundos: the day ends crossing the medieval bridge over the Cávado). Checked against OSM relation 12786090 (Caminho Português de Santiago, ref CP), read through the OSM API on 2026-11-07: the 27.0 km of the relation between the two ends stay within 0.69 km of the straight lines through these points. Published figures seen, not copied into distance_km: Rother 25.7 km, Vagamundos 27.5 km. Santiagoways (a tour operator) cuts this ground differently (Oporto to Fajozes, Fajozes to Arcos, Arcos to Barcelos) and counts 12 stages in all; the 11-stage division of the two guides above is used here.
